title: Nationality encoding in language model hidden states: Probing culturally differentiated representations in persona-conditioned academic text

bias_targets.methodology: Training logistic regression probes on hidden state activations to classify British versus Chinese academic personas during text generation, and analyzing high-signal tokens for structural, lexical, and stance differences.

Evaluating model outputs for culturally differentiated encoding and 'culturally hollow writing' by comparing rhetorical patterns, vocabulary domains, and structural information packaging against established cross-cultural contrastive rhetoric baselines.
